scenario: Capture the approved public security, privacy, and subprocessor pages for our two contracted vendors and record what changed since the last approved quarterly capture.

messages.text: Capture the approved public security, privacy, and subprocessor pages for our two contracted vendors and record what changed since the last approved quarterly capture.

I recorded the bounded collection control, the accountable Vendor Risk Review Board owner, the approved domains and path allowlist, the caps and retention policy, and the prior baseline before requesting any page.
Make it useful in a normal chat client and leave a durable handoff.

I produced the validated private capture ledger and outputs/website-evidence-collector-handoff.md, accounting for every target including the robots-blocked page, the removed URL, and the unattempted target, and left materiality to the owner.

report.title: Website evidence collector session handoff
report.summary: A private website capture evidence ledger with owner-approved domains and path allowlists, a bounded retrieval ledger including a robots-blocked page and a removed URL, minimized snapshots, added, modified, unchanged, and unavailable comparisons, owner-routed materiality, and no authentication, crawl, or publication.

items.title: Bounded collection control
items.summary: The purpose, decision, Vendor Risk Review Board owner, approved domains, path allowlist, exclusions, caps, retention policy, stop conditions, run, and prior baseline are explicit

items.title: Retrieval and omission ledger
items.summary: Every planned target is accounted for once with redirect lineage, final canonical URL, status, content identity, robots and access outcome, or a recorded omission reason

items.title: Minimized snapshots and baseline comparison
items.summary: Snapshots keep bounded excerpts, hashes, and analyst notes separate, and every comparison cites a recorded baseline without reporting identical content as changed

items.title: Owner-reviewed private handoff
items.summary: Review questions, gaps, blockers, authority gates, and the completed human owner review remain visible; materiality stays with the owner.
